data.body: Pushed as Gerrit 2057 (commit 75d8c2526b). Held-out TDD: 8 tests authored, implementer saw only 2 happy-path; RED baseline 7 RED / 1 pinning-green (the _CASCADING_EDGES table test, correctly green before and after). Two mutations killed by their exact held-out tests: removing the benign-race TOCTOU re-check killed test_a_benign_parent_race_still_lets_the_child_proceed; removing the cycle guard killed test_a_malformed_parent_cycle_terminates. Gates: lint rc=0, mypy 626 files clean, complexity new=0 increased=0 with claim_compute and _cascade_parent_first both going STALE (i.e. simpler), 48 tests green including all 32 in test_claim_transition_parent_cascade.py and all 7 in test_inbound_status_cascade.py with zero assertion edits. CONVERGENCE RECORDED per the parent epic's clause: the two call sites previously raised differently worded failures ('cannot claim X: claiming its parent Y failed first' vs 'cannot move X to Z: transitioning its parent Y to Z failed first'); a single verb-parameterised message cannot reproduce both, so they now share one wording. No test asserts that text; docs/concurrency.md:117 quoted the old claim phrasing and was updated. Exit codes and the ConcurrencyMismatch re-raise are unchanged. apply_inbound_events was deliberately left alone: it already single-sources the DECISION, and its walk returns written event paths topmost-first, an ordering its own suite pins that the shared recursive helper cannot reproduce without complicating the signature.
